MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 8

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 77

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

16. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
